runs.name: g3-evo-default-on
runs.description: step G3 quick look, default s3, 10 min, every part on

evals.js: const f=await moire.folding.now(); const g=moire.grn.census; const s = await moire.sample(); return JSON.stringify({t: moire.time(), alive: s.alive, job: [0,1,2,3,4,5,6].map(k => Math.round(s['census.job.' + k] || 0)), fold: {stressFold: f.stressFold, stress: f.stress, dose: f.dose, buf: f.buf, bufSd: f.bufSd, hidden: f.hidden, buffered: f.buffered, hiddenLinks: f.hiddenLinks, foldLinks: f.foldLinks, drift: f.drift, wirings: f.wirings, lineRefolds: f.lineRefolds, stressed: f.stressed, calm: f.calm, lineages: f.lineages}, rates: moire.folding.rates, grn: g && {types: g.types, lineageN: g.lineageN, lineages: g.lineages.slice(0,3).map(l=>({id:l.id,n:l.n,types:l.types,differ:l.differ}))}})
